description: Put an image into the media library and get its URL back, ready for sb_set. Takes a local path, a URL, or a SEARCH — `query` returns real photographs with their own descriptions, and `pick` uploads the one you chose, or several at once to stock a site you just built. The only way to add an image.

pick.description: The id of the search result to upload — or several ids, which stocks a site in one call

query.description: Search real photographs; read the descriptions, then pick

name: sb_media_upload
